'''Fijil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of unknown [[Species/Legends|species]], who delivered things for [[Osaji Uhares]] on [[Centares/Legends|Centares]]. On one occasion, he delivered Uhares some [[Kommerken steak/Legends|Kommerken steaks]] and some powdered [[ootoowerg]]s and was given by Uhares a coded message to take to [[Osaji Hux]]. Shortly afterward, Fijil was confronted by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were searching for his master.
